---
title: Fregola with clams
id: MAR-0083
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 55
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 1 kg of clams
- 280 g of fregola
- 200 g of tomato sauce
- 2 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
- 1 l of fish stock
- 1 garlic clove
## Method
1. Wash the clams, put them in a bowl with plenty of cold water and let them purge sand for 2 hours.
2. Drain them, put them in a covered pan and let them open over high heat; it will take about 5 minutes.
3. Then shell them.
4. Peel the garlic, let it wilt in a saucepan with the oil and after 4 minutes remove it.
5. Pour in the tomato sauce and bring to a boil.
6. Moisten with the broth and when it boils, pour in the fregola; let it cook for about 20 minutes.
7. Add the shelled clams, mix and serve on plates.
8. You can replace part of the broth with the filtered clam liquid.
